gloss: cutting in line; pushing in; butting in

definitions.gloss: cutting in line; pushing in; butting in
definitions.explanation: cutting in line; pushing in; butting in

examples.japanese: {列|れつ}に{割|わ}り{込|こ}みをしないでください。
{割|わ}り{込|こ}みをした{人|ひと}に{注意|ちゅうい}した。
examples.english: I told off the person who cut in line.

examples.japanese: {高速道路|こうそくどうろ}で{無理|むり}な{割|わ}り{込|こ}みをする{車|くるま}が{多|おお}くて{危|あぶ}ない。
examples.english: There are many cars that dangerously cut in on the expressway.

examples.japanese: {割|わ}り{込|こ}み{処理|しょり}でプログラムの{実行|じっこう}が{中断|ちゅうだん}された。

examples.japanese: ハードウェア{割|わ}り{込|こ}みが{発生|はっせい}した。
タイマー{割|わ}り{込|こ}みを{使|つか}って、{一定|いってい}{間隔|かんかく}でデータを{取得|しゅとく}する。
examples.english: Timer interrupts are used to acquire data at regular intervals.

notes:
The noun form of {割|わ}り{込|こ}む (to cut in, to push in). In everyday life, it most commonly refers to cutting in line or merging aggressively in traffic — both considered rude in Japanese culture. In computing, it refers to hardware or software interrupts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {割|わ}り{込|こ}みをする: to cut in line
- {割|わ}り{込|こ}み{禁止|きんし}: no cutting in line
- {無理|むり}な{割|わ}り{込|こ}み: reckless cutting in (traffic)
- {割|わ}り{込|こ}み{処理|しょり}: interrupt processing (computing)
- {割|わ}り{込|こ}み{信号|しんごう}: interrupt signal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {横入|よこい}り: cutting in line — more colloquial and used almost exclusively for queues, not traffic or computing
- {割|わ}り{込|こ}む: to cut in; to squeeze in — the verb form, covering both physical cutting in and interrupting
